A terrestrial '''planet''' existed on [[the fringe]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bruhn]] began to succumb to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]<ref name="Fallen Jedi" /> at some point by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Fallen Jedi" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of which [[Bruhn]] had [[Death/Legends|died]], must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> he decided to sacrifice himself in order to protect the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] from the effects of his transformation. To that end, Bruhn [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] himself in a [[Burial/Legends|tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], where he eventually [[Death/Legends|died]].<ref name="Fallen Jedi" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&ndash;allied individual sought out Bruhn's tomb, eventually discovering the Jedi's body and returning it to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]],<ref name="Fallen Jedi" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Jedi Order.<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The fringe planet was introduced in a Treasure Hunting Crew Skill mission of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Initially the mission was restricted to Galactic Republic&ndash;aligned player characters, though both that restriction and the information regarding the mission's outcome were later removed from the game.<ref name="Fallen Jedi" />
